description: This file defines an Android IntentService called AlarmIntentService, responsible for handling alarm trigger events, displaying notifications, deleting alarm data, and broadcasting an alarm event.

classes.name: AlarmIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles alarm triggering events, shows notifications, deletes the alarm from storage, and broadcasts an alarm gone-off event.

methods.name: AlarmIntentService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IntentService with its name.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents by showing alarm notifications, deleting the alarm, and broadcasting an alarm went-off event.
